create_staircase_classifier: create a Staircase classifier with a domain size and number of classes for threshold learning
fit_staircase_model: fit a Staircase model on data and labels to learn optimal decision thresholds
predict_staircase_classes: predict class labels for input data using a fitted Staircase model
compute_gini_impurity: compute the Gini impurity of a dataset split on a set of thresholds
calculate_step_impurity: calculate the step-wise Gini impurity for adjacent class pairs across thresholds
